args.title: UI-LI-008 Line Items No-op Save Test

steps.note: Provide a title so the event is valid
Select a template to enable line items
Open the Manage Line Items drawer
Click Save in the drawer without making any changes
Verify the drawer closed (the items button is visible again)
Verify no update/save request was issued to the backend
